verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents model fallback lists, provider-selection routing rules, a cost-optimizing auto-router, and community confirmation of switching models mid-prod with automatic fallback, directly matching policy-based mid-task model switching by cost/capability/availability. missing for 10: no first-party documentation of dynamic mid-task (multi-turn/agent-loop) switching triggered by live capability detection, and no independent benchmark validating fallback behavior under real failure conditions beyond anecdotal community reports.
